# Intertwined — Nest Lorebook (Index & Build Doc)

*The keyword-fired memory for the narrator perch (SillyTavern World Info). This is the human-readable map; the machine-readable file is `lorebook_intertwined.json`, generated by `build_lorebook.py`. Edit the **builder**, not the JSON by hand — then re-run it. 🖤*

---

## Why this exists

Claude Code is the *collaborator* perch — it can read the whole repo, but every scene costs a huge manual retrieval pass and the voices don't auto-load. The **Nest** is the *narrator* perch: this lorebook injects the right canon automatically, by keyword, in small chunks — no RAG pipeline, no clunk. Deterministic, debuggable, cheap on context.

## How the tiering works (the Janitor behaviour, rebuilt)

ST has no single-entry "decay my own detail" field. We reproduce it with **two entries + an inclusion group + a cooldown**:

- A **FULL** entry and a **LITE** entry share the same `key`s and the same `group`.
- FULL has `groupOverride: true` (prioritised in the group) and a `cooldown`.
- When the keyword first appears → FULL wins → fires → goes on cooldown for N turns.
- During those N turns the keyword keeps matching, but FULL is locked out, so **LITE** is the only group member eligible → the short reminder fires instead.
- After the cooldown, FULL refreshes.

That's "recently triggered → serve the lean version," done in config.

### Cooldown conventions (set by Alice)
| Entry type | Cooldown (messages) |
|---|---|
| Characters / people | **5–6** |
| Canon events | **8** |
| Always-on (rules, state) | n/a — `constant: true` |

## Schema cheat-sheet (verified vs. ST `world-info.js`, release)

Defaults live in `build_lorebook.py`'s `entry()`; only the deltas are written per entry.

| Field | Meaning / our convention |
|---|---|
| `key` / `keysecondary` | trigger keywords / optional secondary logic keys |
| `constant` | always injected (rules + state). `false` for keyed entries |
| `position` | `0` = before char defs (used for the two constants); `4` = @ depth (everything else) |
| `depth` / `role` | inject 4 messages deep, as `0` (system) |
| `group` / `groupOverride` / `groupWeight` | inclusion group / prioritise-in-group / weighted-random fallback (FULL 100, LITE 10) |
| `cooldown` / `sticky` / `delay` | the timed effects. We use `cooldown` for tiering |
| `preventRecursion` | **true** across tranche 1 — recursion fenced off to stop runaway token spend |
| `matchWholeWords` | **true** — stops substrings (e.g. "Theo" inside "theory") false-firing |
| `selectiveLogic` | `0` = AND ANY |

## Import & test

1. SillyTavern → **World Info** → **Import** → `lorebook_intertwined.json`.
2. Activate it on the Intertwined character (or globally).
3. Confirm the two `constant` entries (blue dot) are always present; the rest show green (keyed).
4. Test the tiering: mention "Draco" several turns running — full entry first, then the lite reminder for ~5 turns, then full again.
5. Sanity-check `groupOverride` survived import (the "Prioritise" toggle on each FULL entry). If a coin-flip shows up between full/lite, that toggle didn't take — re-check it.

## Future: Nest 2.0 memory layer

`Mnemos` (github.com/mnemos-os/mnemos, Apache 2.0, production since Dec 2025) is an MCP-native memory OS with a "sleep daemon" that consolidates episodic→semantic — close to the Antiquary's decay tier. Candidate to back the *persistent* memory in Nest 2.0 (and possibly plug into Claude Code via MCP). `Polyphonic` (polyphonic.chat) is a multi-AI persistent-workspace platform — close to the "Sable side" of the dream map, but someone else's platform with someone else's rules (we've been burned there before). Both noted in `plans/Nest 2.0 Dream Map.md`; neither is a today-fix. This lorebook is the interim that makes the Nest actually usable now.
